chapterInfo.content:
3
Ninewe asodie ne n’asotwe
1 # Hes 24.6, 9 Due, mogya kuro!
Wo a apoobɔ ne awudie ayɛ wo mu ma
na fomfa to ntwa da wɔ wo mu.
2Ɔpɔnkɔ abaa gyegye, teaseɛnam nan yɛ kirididi,
apɔnkɔ fa mmirika, nteaseɛnam hurihuri.
3Apɔnkɔsotefoɔ nam so reba,
afena te nyinamnyinam, na pea pa sɛ ɔsraman,
atɔfoɔ dɔɔso,
awufoɔ dodoɔ yɛ duru
na afunu nni ano;
wɔsuntisunti wɔn afunu no.
4 # Yes 23.16; Adi 17 Yei nyinaa firi Ninewe,
odwamamfoɔ hoɔfɛfoɔ ntafowayifoɔ no adwamammɔ dodoɔ no,
ɔno na ɔde n’adwamammɔ tɔn amanaman,
na ɔde ne ntafowayie tɔn mmusuakuo.
5 # Yes 47.3 Hwɛ, me ne wo anya,
asafo AWURADE asɛm nie,
na mɛyi w’atadeɛ mmuano afa w’anim,
na mama amanaman ahunu w’adagya,
na ahennie aman ahunu w’ahohora.
6Na mɛto atantanneɛ agu wo so,
na magu w’anim ase,
na mede wo mayɛ ahwɛdeɛ.
7Na obiara a ɔbɛhu woɔ no bɛdwane wo, na waka sɛ:
Ninewe adane kurofo! Hwan na ɔbɛdi ne ho abooboo?
Ɛhe na mɛhwehwɛ awerɛkyekyefoɔ mama woɔ?
Ahantan ne adenya ho nni mfasoɔ
8 # Yer 46.25 Woyɛ sene No-Amon
a ɔte asutene ntam
a nsuo nko atwa ne ho ahyia
a n’aban ne ɛpo
na wɔde ɛpo ayɛ ɛho fasuo no anaa?
9Etiopia ne Misraimfoɔ yɛ ne dɔm
a ɛyɛ den na wɔnni ano; afei nso,
Put ne Libiafoɔ nso di boaa wo.
10 # Yoel 3.3 Yei nyinaa akyi no,
wɔfaa no kɔɔ nnommum mu,
ne mmotafowa nso, wɔde wɔn abobɔ
mmorɔno nyinaa ntweaso akunkum wɔn,
na wɔtwee n’animuonyamfoɔ so ntonto,
na wɔguu ne nnipa akɛseɛ nyinaa mpokyerɛ.
11 # Yer 25.15 Wo nso ahohiahia bɛboro
wo na woayera mu,
na wobɛhwehwɛ
dwanekɔbea ɔtamfoɔ anim.
12W’aban a ɛyɛ den nyinaa bɛyɛ sɛ borɔdɔma nnua
a ɛso wɔ adɔmakan,
sɛ wɔwoso a,
ɛtotɔ odifoɔ anomu.
13Hwɛ, w’akofoɔ
ayɛ mmaa wɔ wo mu,
bue na wɔabue w’asase apono
ama w’atamfo,
ogya ahye w’apono akyiri adaban.
14Sesa nsuo sie ma ntua no,
miamia w’abandenden mu!
Tia dɔteɛ mu wɔ ɛboɔ,
miamia ntaayaa fononoo no mu.
15 # Yoel 1.4 Ɛhɔ ara na ogya bɛhye woɔ,
afena bɛtwa wo
adi wo sɛ ntutummɛ,
mpo sɛ wo dodoɔ te sɛ ntutummɛ,
na wo dɔɔso sɛ mmɛbɛ a.
16Woama w’adwadifoɔ adɔɔso
asene ɔsoro nsoromma;
nanso te sɛ ntutummɛ no wɔgu so fom fa na wɔtu kɔ.
17W’asafohene te sɛ mmɛbɛ,
na wo dɔm a woapɔn wɔn te sɛ mmɛbɛ akuakuo
a wɔsensam ban ho ban ho
awɔ da;
owia firi a, wɔtu kɔ
a obiara biara nnim faako a wɔkorɔ.
18W’ahwɛfoɔ afa mu adeda,
O Asiriahene,
w’animuonyamfoɔ deda hɔ;
wɔabɔ wo man apete mmepɔ so,
na ɔnoboafoɔ nni hɔ.
19Wo kuro nni asayɛ,
wo pira no mu yɛ den;
obiara a ɔte wo nka no
bɔ ne nsam gu wo so,
ɛfiri sɛ hwan koraa so na womfaa
wo daa daa haw no nkɔeɛ?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
